d: Long, voluminous, messy silver-white hair is styled with thick, sweeping bangs and gathered into two large, fluffy side-tufts, topped with a white and cyan nurse's cap. The sharp, narrow eyes are a vibrant cyan blue with a confident, smiling expression on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build is dressed in a futuristic white and cyan medical coat with a black inner lining, featuring a white identification badge and translucent cyan sleeves. A small cyan cross emblem is visible on the front of the headwear.
